specification.description: Elegant beige envelope clutch in faux leather with a crisp standard profile, suited to date night and refined summer looks.
construction_details: Fold-over envelope flap with clean edge piping
Slim faux leather body with a softly padded front panel
Concealed magnetic closure beneath the flap
specification.care_instructions: Wipe gently with a soft, slightly damp cloth; avoid soaking, friction and direct heat during storage.

quality_adjustments: Synthetic capacity defined as 70% of external volume, rounded down to 0.1 L, to correct impossible generated volume.
